title: Unsigned cipher slip, Brussels 9 Oct 1721, in the Cologne nunciature archive (ASV Arch. Nunz. Colonia 5 f. 26r, DECODE R24)

steps.what: DECODE R24 fetched with the session cookie: 1 image, transcription, Lasry key, Lasry segmented decryption, Bonavoglia reading.
DECODE figures checked against the image line by line; heading read as Brusselles 9 ott.re 1721.
18 = qu (qualche, quel, questo), 55 = gli (ma egli), 67 = g (grat-) from context.
45 9441 43 (before -te divinis), 9336 9485 (before di Tournai), 9356, 76: no second occurrence to confirm any value; left open.

outcome.method_basis: Lasry's reconstructed key ASV-C15, his segmented decryption and Bonavoglia's reading were already attached to DECODE R24; the key was re-applied, three values added from context (18 = qu, 55 = gli, 67 = g?) and the transcription checked against the image.
outcome.notes: 182 of 189 tokens valued; reading already on DECODE by Lasry/Bonavoglia; three values added here.

prior.where: Lasry key ASV-C15 and segmented decryption (Nov 2020) and Bonavoglia reading with English translation, attached to DECODE R24

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
